collection_method: One-time normal web-reader review of the complete official results page. No raw HTML copied; no build-time IWF requests. CUA browser was unavailable.
finished_observation_basis: All sixteen completed category classifications observed on this date; this is an observation upper bound, not an actual session end or scheduled timetable date.
lot_identity_basis: LOTs retained from the previously audited official result-book identities, not extracted from the results page. The corroborated source-name variant is recorded separately.

identity_name_variants.basis: Prior complete-source audit corroborated unique category/group/nation, all three global ranks, six attempt weights and best/total values; no fuzzy name matching.
